## Body

#259 (merged 31f9ef20) and #261 (merged 4c899c0a) are live-proven on main. Builds on the F208 note.

- The contract (`just copilot-sdk-contract`) runs the REAL extension.mjs in a child process. `@microsoft/copilot-sdk/extension` is resolved to `~/.copilot/pkg/<plat>-<arch>/<copilot --version>/copilot-sdk/extension.js`, and the script plays the CLI on that SDK's JSON-RPC stdio wire (connect, session.resume, hooks.invoke, session.event, session.tools.handlePendingToolCall). A shim wraps the config's functions in place to report calls, so the check never encodes a shape: flat passes on 1.0.112, fails on 1.0.113+.
- R259-001 lesson: facts on stderr and answers on stdout have no order between them. Never take a stdout answer as proof that a stderr fact arrived. Use a barrier: send an event the shim answers on the same stderr, after every earlier fact. Read with readline, never by chunk. Regression: a parent-only preload that delays and splits child stderr (fixtures/copilot-sdk-contract-late-stderr.mjs).
- R261-001 lesson: an approval must name the exact version it checked AND recorded, and that must equal the version installed now (report.version == report.verified == after). Self-updates make "the pass I just got" possibly about a different binary.
- The pass/warn/fail wording lives in the pure copilot-sdk-verdict.mjs so CI (no Copilot CLI) can pin it. Updater seams: PIJ_COPILOT_UPDATE_CMD and PIJ_COPILOT_SDK_CONTRACT_CMD (executables, no shell). Never run a real `copilot update`: it updates the fleet's CLI.
- TRAP: the edit tool resolves RELATIVE paths against the spawn cwd (the main checkout), not your worktree. I once mutated the live main-checkout extension.mjs for a minute (harmless). From a worktree, always give edit/read absolute paths.
- Nice rule (far-jackal, until F220): just recipes nice themselves since #257. An outer `nice -n 19` stacks to 20 and fails shared-build.test.ts "nice 19 alone". Put nice only on direct node, vitest or cargo calls.
- `just doctor` and `_copilot-native-install-check` refuse in linked worktrees (omp-doctor and link checks), so prove doctor lines in the canonical checkout.
